mapper.select: SELECT id, spu_id, sku_code, barcode, spec_name, spec_values, sale_unit, product_type, market_price, status, is_default, sort_order, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM product_sku WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT s.id, s.spu_id, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.barcode, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, s.sale_unit, s.product_type, s.market_price, s.status, s.is_default, s.sort_order, s.version, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.created_by, s.updated_by FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND s.id IN #{skuId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id, s.spu_id, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.barcode, s.spec_name, s.spec_values, s.sale_unit, s.product_type, s.market_price, s.status, s.is_default, s.sort_order, s.version, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.created_by, s.updated_by FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' ORDER BY s.sku_code, s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'SYSTEM' WHERE spu_id = #{spuId} AND deleted = FALSE AND is_default = TRUE
